acquisition.model: ordinary constant-SPD Langevin; unit longitudinal mobility and zero cross mobility
acquisition.family: all fixed real atom weights in their declared intervals; F=vU+defect*gV, 0<=V<=U globally

certificate.observable: mean and all-time absolute CDF of tau_{Y>=1/2}, uniformly over every fixed admitted atom-weight choice, from its OWN EXACT FULL Gibbs conditioned on Y<=-1/2
certificate.actual_generator_family: beta^-1 d_yy - F_y d_y + beta^-1 trace(M Hess_z) - (M grad_z F) dot grad_z; F=vU+defect*gV
